P.name: Drakehound's Step
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} During the {{tip|lockout}} of '''Ambessa's''' {{tip|abilities}}, inputting an {{tt|attack or movement command|Default MB2/right click}} causes her to {{tip|dash}} to or {{tt|towards|If inputted outside of the maximum dash range, she will dash the maximum distance towards the target/location}} the target or location, respectively, after the lockout ends. This dash cannot pass through terrain.
'''''Ambessa''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Ambessa''' casts an ability, she generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Medarda Maxim'' after the ability's respective lockout for 4 seconds, refreshing with subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. Basic attacks consume one stack each to become empowered.
P.description3: {{sbc|Medarda Maxim:}} '''Ambessa's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|75 '''bonus''' range}} and {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|{{pplevel|5 to 30}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and restore {{sti|energy|{{as|{{pp|40 to 70|1;7;13}} energy}}}}.

Q.name: Cunning Sweep
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}}, at the end of which she slashes with her twin drakehounds in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against enemies hit by the outer edge.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending, and '''Ambessa''' will perform the dash after her slash completes.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|40/2 to 120/2}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2 to 6/2}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Increased Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4 to 6}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: If this hits at least one enemy, '''Ambessa''' can cast ''{{ai|Sundering Slam|Ambessa}}'' within the next 4 seconds.
Q.description3: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Cunning Sweep'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} and the damage based on their health ratio is capped at {{pplevel|100 to 300}}.

Q.name: Sundering Slam
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}}, at the end of which she slams her twin drakehounds in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against the first enemy hit.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending, and '''Ambessa''' will perform the dash after her slam completes.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|50/2 to 150/2}} {{as|(+ 45% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2 to 6/2}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Increased Physical Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4 to 6}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Sundering Slam'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} and the damage based on their health ratio is capped at {{pplevel|100 to 300}}.

W.name: Repudiation
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' braces herself for up to {{fd|0.5}} seconds, during which in the first {{fd|0.225}} seconds she is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. After '''Ambessa''' finishes bracing, she smashes the ground beneath her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.25}} seconds of the lockout ending.
W.description2: Additionally, '''Ambessa''' {{tip|shield|shields}} herself at the time of cast for {{pplevel|50 to 320}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. If the shield mitigates any amount of damage taken from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}} before '''Ambessa''' smashes the ground, ''Repudiation's'' damage is increased by 50%.
W.description3: '''''Ambessa''' will smash the ground at the end of {{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}} dash if she would finish bracing during it, and otherwise always smashes the ground from wherever she is at the end of the bracing time.''

E.name: Lacerate
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}} and spins her twin drakehounds around her to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them by 99% decaying over 1 second.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending; in either case, she will spin a second time at the end of the dash to apply the same effects at no additional cost.
E.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

R.name: Public Execution
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ambessa''' gains {{sti|{{as|armor penetration}}}} and {{tip|heals}} herself for a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} she deals to enemies with her active abilities. The healing effectiveness is reduced to 25% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Armor Penetration|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}}
{{st|Healing Percentage|{{ap|15 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 50% life steal)}}|Reduced Healing Percentage|{{ap|15*0.25 to 20*0.25}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% life steal)}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' prepares a strike in a line in the target direction, then {{tip|blinks}} behind the farthest enemy champion within the area and seizes them. If she {{tt|successfully|See notes}} seizes the target, '''Ambessa''' {{tip|attach|attaches}} them to herself and {{tip|suppression|suppresses}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. While the target is suppressed, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and '''Ambessa''' picks them up off the ground before crashing them back down, afterwards dealing {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.4}} seconds.
R.description3: '''''Ambessa''' is {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} during the cast time and while the target is suppressed. {{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}} dash may be buffered during the cast time or lockout, as well as initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending.''
